title: Appliance Repair Form
subtitle: Residential Appliance Repair: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Appliance Repair Form covers household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish. The home appliance service coordinator records Residential Appliance Repair activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Appliance Repair Form keeps Residential Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the home appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Form at residence, room, appliance position, utility connection, and protected work area. Document household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish identity before Residential Appliance Repair begins. Compare household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish findings with stated Residential Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Residential Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance technician. For Appliance Repair Form, confirm requirements for Residential Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance technician to review Residential Appliance Repair conditions beyond the home appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Task record and responsible parties
sections.guidance: For Residential Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, residence, room, appliance position, utility connection, and protected work area, and the linked household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish source.

fields.label: Appliance type, make, model, and serial
Symptom, fault code, cycle, load, and prior repair history

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Appliance Repair facts for household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Appliance Repair operating checks
items: Power, gas, water, drain, and vent connection
Door, seal, latch, interlock, and enclosure
Motor, pump, fan, heater, sensor, and control behavior
Leak, drainage, airflow, temperature, and cycle result
Floor, cabinet, wall, and surrounding property condition

sections.title: Operating exception, outcome, and review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Appliance Repair conditions; have home appliance service coordinator assign the next Residential Appliance Repair owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Gas, electrical, water, refrigerant, or combustion concern
Property damage or test condition outside scope
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Appliance Repair when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, part concern, property risk, or unsafe test remains. Retain the available Residential Appliance Repair proof and route unresolved household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish scope to home appliance service coordinator.
